$comment: Each mutant removes one guard. `spec` edits the model and TLC must report `expect` (or nothing, for `survives`). `code` makes the same edit to the implementation and the named test must fail under it and pass without it. Run: bun scripts/spec/mutants.ts [--spec-only|--code-only] [--only <id>]. See spec/tla/README.md.

mutants.title: the fence admits a transaction whose token is not the row's

code.before: WHERE id=$1 AND acquisition_token=$2::uuid AND ttl_expires_at > now() FOR SHARE
code.after: WHERE id=$1 AND $2::uuid IS NOT NULL AND ttl_expires_at > now() FOR SHARE

mutants.title: the fence reads the row without FOR SHARE, so a takeover proceeds under an open transaction
the upsert takes over a row whose TTL has not expired

code.before:
WHERE gbrain_cycle_locks.ttl_expires_at < NOW()
           AND (gbrain_cycle_locks.last_refreshed_at IS NULL
                OR gbrain_cycle_locks.last_refreshed_at < NOW() - $5 * INTERVAL '1 second')
code.filter: does NOT reclaim a live same-host holder

mutants.title: release deletes the row whatever its token, so a former holder frees its successor's lease

code.filter: release\(\) after a steal is a fenced no-op

mutants.title: the dead-pid takeover reclaims a live holder (EPERM read as dead, or --force-break-lock)
#7415: back-to-back fenced transactions that each outlive the renewal timeout starve the renewal until the lease lapses
a new fenced transaction overtakes a renewal waiting on the row (the RenewalWinsGap assumption fails)
the renewal extends whatever row exists, so a late renewal from a former holder rewinds its successor's expiry

code.filter: after a steal, the old handle refresh\(\) returns false

mutants.title: the fence ignores an aborted lease signal
mutants.reason: Defense in depth: every abort is also visible to the fence's token or expiry check (the local deadline never outlasts the row's expiry, and a refused renewal means the token moved).

mutants.title: the fence admits under an expired row that nobody took over
mutants.reason: Defense in depth: FOR SHARE blocks a takeover while the transaction is open, and the token check refuses after one. test/persistence-sync-lease.test.ts still pins the refusal ("expired untaken").
